Integrations.atLeastOnce: The same event may arrive more than once. Your server must ignore a repeat by its event id — exactly-once delivery does not exist over a network.
Integrations.delayNotice: Sending happens in the background and usually starts within a minute. Nothing is sent from the till itself.
Integrations.deliveriesEmpty: Nothing has been sent to this destination yet.
Integrations.destinationsEmptyBody: Add one below. It starts disabled, so you can check the address before anything is sent.
Integrations.disabledNotice: This destination is disabled. Nothing is sent to it.
Integrations.emptyBody: An entry appears here when a member of staff records an offer at the counter, or when one is withdrawn. Events recorded before this feature existed are not shown, because they were never written.
Integrations.error: That did not work. Try again.
Integrations.errorForbidden: Only the owner may manage webhook destinations.
Integrations.errorInvalid: Check the address and try again.
Integrations.errorPort: Webhook endpoints must use HTTPS port 443.
Integrations.errorTaken: That name or address is already in use.
Integrations.errorTestPending: A test is already waiting to be sent to this destination. It goes out within about a minute.
Integrations.historyHint: One entry per completed offer redemption and per withdrawal, written at the same moment as the action itself. Newest first.
Integrations.nameHint: What you call it. Only you see this.
Integrations.noBodies: Only the outcome and the status code are kept. No response, no address and no secret is stored or shown here.
Integrations.noContactData: No phone number, email address, code, card, wallet pass or amount is kept in these entries — only which kind of thing happened, and when.
Integrations.nothingConnected: No provider is connected. There is no email, SMS, WhatsApp, payment or point-of-sale integration here, and nothing that could create one. The only thing this product sends is a signed copy of these events to an address you set up yourself, below.
Integrations.outcomeAddress: The address could not be used. Check it and create a new destination.
Integrations.outcomeKeyMissing: Paused: this server is missing a setting it needs before it can send. An administrator can restore it, and anything waiting will be tried again.
Integrations.outcomeNetwork: Your server could not be reached. It will be tried again.
Integrations.outcomeNotEligible: Nothing was sent, because this destination was not enabled at the time.
Integrations.outcomeRateLimited: Your server asked us to slow down. It will be tried again.
Integrations.outcomeRedirect: Your server redirected the request. Redirects are not followed; give the final address instead.
Integrations.outcomeServerError: Your server reported an error. It will be tried again.
Integrations.outcomeTimeout: Your server did not answer in time. It will be tried again.
Integrations.outcomeTls: Your server's security certificate was not accepted.
Integrations.outcomeUnreadable: This destination's saved settings can no longer be read. Create a new destination and remove this one.
Integrations.revokeConfirm: Revoking is permanent. This destination can never be enabled again.
Integrations.roadmap: Which providers could ever be connected, and what each one would need first, is written down in the integrations capability audit rather than implied by this screen.
Integrations.rotateConfirm: The old secret stops working immediately. Update your server in the same sitting.
Integrations.secretHow: Your server should recompute HMAC-SHA-256 over the timestamp, a dot, and the body, then compare it with the signature header.
Integrations.secretWarning: Copy this now. It is stored scrambled and can never be shown again — if you lose it, rotate it and update your server.
Integrations.subtitle: What this business has recorded, and where you have asked for it to be sent.
Integrations.testQueued: A test was queued. It carries no customer data — just a fixed sample — and is sent in the background.
Integrations.title: Integrations
Integrations.urlHint: Must start with https:// and point at a public hostname on the standard port 443. Not an IP address, not a private network, not another port.
Integrations.webhooksHint: Send these events to a server you control. HTTPS only, and only you can set one up.
Integrations.webhooksUnavailable: Webhook delivery is not configured on this server. Nothing can be created or sent until the encryption key is in place.

Wallet.appleNote: The link is a back field. Apple renders no button on the front of a pass, and a capability does not belong on a lock screen.
Wallet.barcodeNote: Neither barcode carries the invitation link. The barcode is the card's scanner code and is unchanged.
Wallet.deviceGate: Not verified on a real iPhone or Android device yet. That check is a manual gate before production.
Wallet.error: That did not work. Try again.
Wallet.googleNote: The link is a linksModuleData URI, which is the official place for a tappable web link on a Google pass.
Wallet.linkEverIssued: {count, plural, =0 {None issued} one {1 issued in total} other {# issued in total}}
Wallet.linkLive: This card has a live invitation link.
Wallet.linkNone: This card has no invitation link yet. One is created when a wallet pass is issued.
Wallet.notSigned: Not signed. This build has no Apple Pass Type certificate and no Google service-account key, so no pass can be issued yet.
Wallet.notStampCard: Wallet passes are built for stamp cards only in this phase.
Wallet.reinstallNote: A pass already saved in a customer's wallet does not gain the link on its own. It appears when the pass is issued again and saved again. Nothing in this build pushes an update to a saved pass.
Wallet.revokeConfirm: Revoke it? The link in the customer's wallet stops working, and the pass has to be issued again for a new one.
Wallet.revokeNothing: There was no live link to revoke.
Wallet.subtitle: What this card would look like in Apple Wallet and Google Wallet, and where the invitation link sits.
Wallet.title: Wallet pass
Wallet.tokenHidden: The link itself is never shown here. It belongs to the customer, in their wallet.
